lead.headline: Poochinski went from 37.36 down to 99%
lead.dek: At 4:48 PM Poochinski led Cherry Blossom by 0.74 and the board called it a 29.6% team. At 8:49 PM it leads 191.84 to 168.2, and Cherry Blossom’s whole Monday is one defense.
lead.pull: Down 37.36 at 1:49 PM. Up 23.64 at 8:49 PM. That’s a 61-point swing, and Poochinski did it with the bye-week quarterback it signed at 9:28 AM.
body: I said this afternoon that Sunday night would decide it. It did, and it wasn’t close. The game was a mirror match: Poochinski had Aaron Rodgers and Chase Brown on the field, Cherry Blossom had Jaylen Warren and Tee Higgins. Poochinski’s pair put up 43.32. Cherry Blossom’s put up 20.7. That’s the matchup.

Chase Brown did the damage, 28.3 against a 13.72 projection. Rodgers was fine, not great: 15.02 against 17.49. Doesn’t matter. The 9:28 AM add of a quarterback for a bye week is now a starter in a win, and the front office gets to say it was the plan all along.

Cherry Blossom’s side of the ledger is cruel. Warren finished at 9.1 against 17.07 and Higgins at 11.6 against 17.19. Christian McCaffrey’s 46.3 and Parker Washington’s 28.2 built a 168.2 that wins most weeks. This week it’s second place by 23.64.

Here’s the Monday math. Cherry Blossom has exactly one player left, the Ravens D/ST, projected 8.34, kicking off Monday at 5:15 PM. It needs more than 23.64 from a defense to win. The live board says 1%. Poochinski is finished at 191.84, the highest score on the board this week, and it’s waiting with nobody left to play.

The only blemish is the one I flagged this afternoon: Quinshon Judkins scored 16.1 on the bench while Javonte Williams scored 7.7 in the flex. At 4:48 PM that was the whole margin. Now it’s a footnote. Pick: Poochinski, 99%.

quick_hits.headline: Maye needs 11.65 from Zay Flowers. He’s projected 16.24.
quick_hits.body: Evan McPherson kicked 7.0 for Bad things man bad things, and the lead grew from 4.64 to 11.64: 172.72 to 161.08, with Bad things finished. Maye I touch your TDs? has one bullet, Zay Flowers, Monday at 5:15 PM. He needs more than 11.64; the projection says 177.32 to 172.72 and the board says 69.3% Maye. The only matchup in R.A.T.S. still in doubt, and it comes down to one receiver. Pick: Maye I touch your TDs?.

quick_hits.headline: Chase added 34.1. Final: 178.08 to 123.24.
quick_hits.body: Ja’Marr Chase was supposed to be dessert. He was a second entrée: 34.1 against a 19.89 projection, and deeboliciouskins finishes 54.84 ahead of Big Stric Energy. George Pickens’ 43.5 and Patrick Mahomes’ 35.42 did the rest, with D’Andre Swift’s bye still sitting in the RB slot. Nobody needed him.

quick_hits.headline: DK Metcalf scored 15.4 on the bench tonight
quick_hits.body: Big Stric Energy finished at 123.24 hours ago. Then its bench receiver DK Metcalf went for 15.4 on Sunday night, 15.1 more than Jalen Coker’s 0.3 in the flex. It wouldn’t have closed a 54.84 gap. It will still sting.

quick_hits.headline: Burrow: 33.16. The Finest: 190.86.
quick_hits.body: Joe Burrow beat his 22.43 projection by more than ten, and the 2-7 Finest posted 190.86, second only to Poochinski this week. AB81 sits at 88.26, down 102.6, with Justin Herbert, Derrick Henry and Mark Andrews left on Monday, projected 36.41 combined. The board says 100%. The 7-2 team is about to lose to the 2-7 team by a lot.

quick_hits.headline: The 4:33 PM rescue squad scored 10.7
quick_hits.body: AB81’s Sunday-night trio delivered: Rico Dowdle 4.7 against 9.91, the Bengals D/ST 5.0 against 6.35, Germie Bernard 1.0 against 11.05. That moved AB81 from 77.56 to 88.26. Herbert, Henry and Andrews play Monday at 5:15 PM for a live projection of 124.67.

quick_hits.headline: deeboliciouskins benched 64.3 and won by 54.84
quick_hits.body: Tony Pollard 23.9, the Vikings D/ST 21.0 and DJ Moore 19.4 never left deeboliciouskins’ bench. Bad things man bad things left Kirk Cousins’ 16.38 there, 5.4 more than starter Tyler Shough. Cherry Blossom sat Michael Penix Jr. (13.34) and started Brock Bowers (3.8) in the flex.
